answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost that cannot be copied. Every new agent must post a bond through a bridge contract that locks funds for two epochs, and each attestation is written to a public mirror ledger. Before an identity may vote, three reviewers must sign it, and those reviewers' own history must show an unbroken ripple of undisputed attestations. A disputed vote propagates backward, quarantining both the reviewer and the sponsor. Anyone can replay the ledger and check bond age; if an agent's bond drops below the epoch median, its vote weight goes to zero.
